2607.28457.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
2607.28457.paper_summary: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.
2607.28457.paper_summary_zh: 擴展測試時的計算可以改善語言模型的推理，但均勻的預算會在簡單輸入上浪費計算，而驗證者引導的精煉則依賴於外部反饋。我們介紹了自我驗證精煉（Self-Verifying Refinement, SVR），這是一個無oracle的多輪強化學習框架，學習將自我驗證作為計算控制策略。在每一輪中，模型生成一個解決方案，並附帶一個離散的正確性判斷和一個置信度分數；只有當判斷為正確且置信度超過閾值時，它才保留當前答案，否則繼續使用自己的自我驗證進行精煉。真實正確性僅用於構建訓練獎勵，並不會通過精煉提示暴露給策略或在推理時要求。SVR使用GRPO在固定時間範圍內的軌跡上進行訓練，使用促進解決方案正確性、校準感知自我驗證和停止準備正確狀態的獎勵；自適應停止僅在推理時啟用。在七個數學推理基準上，使用Qwen3.5-2B，SVR的宏平均準確率為0.563，平均僅需2.99次推理輪次。在評估的完整系統比較中，它超越了標準GRPO、強多輪基準和固定預算的oracle引導分數反饋參考，同時所需的輪次遠低於固定的十輪推理。這些結果顯示，學習到的自我驗證可以作為答案保留和自適應測試時計算分配的有效內部控制信號。
